      "observations": [
        "Full LF-response workaround diff read. IncorporateComplete calls parser HandleLine(\"\",0) before flushing the stream and publishing the header. The current sink additionally guards the optional parser and requires output stream, then flushes, finishes new message, sets storeToken and publishes/filter-forwards. The empty signal is not written into the mailbox and adds zero input bytes to parser position.",
        "Full selected accepted sink lifecycle, parser state/macro, current JS TOP/RETR owners and IDL read. EMPTY_MESSAGE_LINE recognizes CR/LF/zero, but author explains LF input arrived as one long parser line; the macro alone does not prove line splitting was correct. Header completion is state-guarded, so normal body state does not reparse headers, though its body-line counter still advances on HandleLine. Current TOP passes server size, RETR zero; each completion failure invokes incorporateAbort.",
        "D229454 full timeline and all four actual historical rows read. BenC accepts HandleLine workaround, explicitly leaves root parser issue for follow-up and rejects extra m_blankLineDetected because parser state already suffices. Author agrees/removes it. The reviewer question remains NotDone even though final revision explicitly accepted; no claim root cause fixed. Reviewer posts sanity Try link, no observed local result.",
        "Existing current POP command test read with1336 covers TOP/RETR selection under size/headers-only preferences; the historical landing adds no LF-only regression test. Parser completion error can propagate, while WriteLineToMailbox ignores HandleLine status; no all-parser-errors-propagate claim.",
        "Full Bug1911477 rendered description/comments0–70 read. Import, corruption, old msgOffset, filter and store-format theories are investigated but fresh Maildir/no-filter setup still reproduces. Reporter distinguishes blank list metadata from correct rendered message and repaired existing entries; repairing does not fix future downloads. Gene confirms on supplied test account. Early extra-newline explanation59/63 is superseded by c66: the write happened to trigger parser completion, not a necessary extra mailbox newline. Initial nsPop3Sink.cpp-fix.diff and alternative LineReader.diff are discussion-only, not new source audits. c68 says normalizing wire LF is still only a workaround; local message-copy parsing also matters and precise derived-class confinement remains uncertain. Core follow-up1932774 and later regression1934417 remain open context, not a claim this workaround fixes all parsing.",

Reviewer offers OSX Try artifact for reporter; this body has no reporter confirmation of that artifact.
